subject.title: Feature: Trigger model fallback on context length exceeded

question: Should exhausted context overflow remain a compaction-only terminal condition, or may OpenClaw retry the active turn on a configured larger-context fallback model?
rationale: The choice changes cross-provider replay semantics, tool side-effect safety, model-selection persistence, and how much trust runtime routing places in context-window metadata.

options.title: Add guarded larger-model fallback
options.body: Retry only at a replay-safe boundary after normal overflow recovery fails, filtering configured candidates to those with trustworthy larger context windows and recording the routing event.

options.title: Keep compaction-only behavior
options.body: Retain the current terminal overflow result and document that operators must manually switch models or start a new session after recovery is exhausted.

options.title: Require explicit opt-in policy
options.body: Add an operator-controlled setting that preserves compaction-only behavior by default and enables guarded context-overflow fallback when configured.

recommendation.title: Add guarded larger-model fallback
recommendation.body: Retry only at a replay-safe boundary after normal overflow recovery fails, filtering configured candidates to those with trustworthy larger context windows and recording the routing event.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the strongest combined history in the fallback and embedded-runner paths and already reviewed the issue's product boundary.
